location.description: docker:/ for the whole daemon, docker:/volumes/<name>, docker:/containers/<name>, docker:/networks/<name> or docker:/images/<repo>/<tag> to narrow it; docker+container://<container> or docker+image://<image> for a flat export; with nothing after :// a docker save archive is read from stdin

pause.description: pause the running containers that use a volume while its data is read (default false)

kubelet_image.description: image run with the volume mounted to read its data; defaults to the k8s integration's kubelet image
